`rar5-compressed.rar` is decoded from the uuencoded fixture
`libs/libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_compressed.rar.uu` in
libarchive 3.8.10. Its source test is `test_read_format_rar5.c` and carries
the 3-clause BSD license (copyright 2018 Grzegorz Antoniak); that license is
included in the libarchive source distribution's `COPYING` notice. The fixture
contains one `test.bin` file of 1,200 bytes. The test regenerates those bytes
with the formula documented in that upstream test and compares every byte.

SHA-256: `68f9d7e2662cd5bc5607ba9c6bf1edbf121cf3b08011a7d8643091791750a7c8`.

`rar4-subblock.rar.uu` is the upstream
`libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar_subblock.rar.uu` fixture from the same
libarchive revision. Its source test is `test_read_format_rar.c`, under the
3-clause BSD notice reproduced in libarchive's `COPYING`. The test decodes the
fixture in its temporary directory and verifies the legacy RAR reader's sole
`test.txt` entry against the upstream literal `test text document\r\n`.

The ZIP and 7z fixtures are generated by the tests using the pinned libarchive
writer. The 7z writer is explicitly set to LZMA2; it is not whatever codec the
writer happens to choose by default. Both contain only the literal test payload
in `ArchiveBackend.test.cpp`.
